question: Can a 60% Functional Form / 40% Cultural Expression balance create mature India-oriented mid-range exteriors?

userFeedback.comment: 第一张类似印度的袍，方向较好；摄像头应在纹样线一侧而不是压线。其他方向有些为求不同而求异。60/40 可能让文化表达过重，下一批改为 80/20。

verdict: Textile character worked when carried by a secondary surface field, but cultural geometry overrode mature phone form in the other concepts.
schemaLearning: Use an 80/20 default. Cultural Expression may enrich a resolved physical zone but must not determine major body volume, camera position, or primary camera-island topology unless the brief explicitly grants that role.
